notes: Latitude is planetocentric, longitude is east-positive in 0-360 degrees. 'approximate': true means the coordinate is the centre of a region, not a specific landing point. Surface heights are not stored here; they are read from the LOLA terrain.

sites.name: Connecting Ridge
sites.coordinate_basis: Candidate landing site 'CR06' (region code CR) from the dataset of Wueller et al. (2026): among the 9 sites of the region, the one with the most sunlit days in their model summed over 2027-2029. A site proposed in a peer-reviewed study, not a NASA-selected landing point.
